name: Necromancer Graverobber cuts Raise and Animate mana cost and cast time by 30% (#1038)
contract: Graverobber 503757 is a Necromancer Animation talent (CharacterAdvancement 30022, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 61 Animation, TalentEssenceCost 1). Its client description reads 'Reduces the mana cost and cast time of your Raise and Animate spells by $s1%.' Both effects are SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with BasePoints -31 + DieSides 1 = -30 in SpellFamilyName 29: effect 0 MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) with EffectSpellClassMask (0x8, 0x10000, 0x20000000) and effect 1 MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) with (0x8, 0x10000, 0). No Necromancer contract rewrites aura 108, and every Raise/Animate summon carries family flag word 0 0x8: Raise: Ghoul 500971 (ManaCostPercentage 28, 1500 ms cast), Raise: Skeletal Mage 500331 (40%, 2000 ms) and Animate: Plaguefather 805048 (25%, 2000 ms). Flesh to Worms 500338 (12%, family flags 0x4000, 0, 0x20) is neither and keeps its cost. SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost and Unit::ModSpellCastTime apply the caster's modifiers, so with the talent the three casts take 1050/1400/1400 ms and cost 70% of their untalented mana (integer truncation keeps the ratio within 0.69-0.705). A real Raise: Ghoul cast must start a cast of at most 1050 ms, raise the Ghoul and spend 70% of the untalented cost; the fixture's regeneration is suppressed so the spend is exact.
